# PoopCheck

> AI-powered stool analysis and gut health tracking app with 25,000+ users worldwide.

PoopCheck uses computer vision and AI to analyze stool photos using the Bristol Stool Scale, providing personalized gut health scores, trend tracking, and actionable health insights. Available free on iOS and Android.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://poopcheck.app/): AI poop analyzer — scan your stool and track gut health
- [Features](https://poopcheck.app/features/): Complete feature overview including AI analysis, gut score, and community
- [AI Stool Analysis](https://poopcheck.app/features/ai-stool-analysis/): How our AI analyzes stool photos using the Bristol Scale
- [Pricing](https://poopcheck.app/pricing/): Free and Premium plan comparison
- [Demo](https://poopcheck.app/demo/): Try AI stool analysis online
- [Download](https://poopcheck.app/download/): Download for iOS and Android

## For Businesses & Developers

PoopCheck licenses the technology behind the app. There is no other publicly
available commercial API for Bristol Stool Form Scale image classification.

- [For Business](https://poopcheck.app/business/): Stool analysis API and annotated dataset licensing for health startups, researchers and ML teams
- [Stool Analysis API](https://poopcheck.app/business/api/): Computer-vision endpoint returning Bristol Stool Scale type (1-7), color, consistency, shape, mucus and blood indicators from a single photo. Access by request.
- [Annotated Stool Dataset](https://poopcheck.app/business/data/): The largest annotated stool image collection in existence - real-world smartphone photos labeled with Bristol type plus multi-label color and pathology annotations. Research licenses include publication rights; commercial licenses available. Custom subsets can be scoped.
- [Public stool & microbiome dataset index](https://poopcheck.app/poopcheck-blog/public-stool-and-gut-microbiome-datasets-2026/): Independent index of 26 stool and gut-microbiome datasets, with access routes and licensing terms for each
